description: Delta MS300 compact drive (built-in RS-485 Modbus): control and status words, output measurements, and the main communication parameters
source: Delta MS300 Series User Manual, chapter 12 section 9 (Modbus), and MS300 High Speed Model User Manual

sources.title: Delta Standard Compact Drive MS300 Series User Manual
sources.note: 2000H-2101H address list checked against the standard-model manual page (12.1-09-8)

sources.title: Delta MS300 (High Speed Model) User Manual
sources.note: chapter 12 address list, 2102H onward, and Pr.09 parameters; same Modbus layout

notes: A parameter GG-nn is the holding register 0xGGnn (Pr.04-01 is 0x0401). Functions 03, 06 and 10 are supported.
Factory serial format is ASCII 7N2 at 9.6 kbit/s, station 1 (Pr.09-04 = 1). This map assumes RTU 8N2 (Pr.09-04 = 13), so set that parameter first.
The control word (0x2000) and the fault word (0x2002) are write-only; they are listed as bit fields. To start the drive, write run and direction in one 0x2000 write.
To control the drive over the link set the frequency source (Pr.00-20) and the operation source (Pr.00-21) to RS-485, then write 0x2001 or Pr.09-10.

The registers from 0x2102 on were read from the MS300 High Speed Model manual, which shares the layout of the standard model; the extra registers of the 0x2200 block are not listed. Pr.09-01 (baud rate) is not listed because its raw scale is not stated clearly in the manual.
Written from the manufacturer's manuals; not tested on a device.

registers.name: Run command
registers.description: Bits 1-0 of the command word: stop or run.

registers.name: Direction command
registers.description: Bits 5-4 of the command word.

registers.name: Accel/decel selection
registers.description: Bits 7-6 of the command word: acceleration and deceleration set to use.

registers.name: Use bits 6-11 of command word
registers.description: Bit 12: 1 enables the accel/decel selection and the multi-speed step in bits 6-11 of the command word.

registers.name: Speed step command
registers.description: Bits 11-8 of the command word: 0 = master speed, 1 to 15 = multi-step speed 1 to 15. Takes effect when bit 12 is set.

registers.name: Operation source command
registers.description: Bits 14-13 of the command word.

registers.name: Frequency command
registers.description: Frequency set point in 0.01 Hz (5000 = 50.00 Hz).

registers.name: External fault
registers.description: Bit 0: 1 raises an external fault (EF).

registers.name: Fault reset
registers.description: Bit 1: 1 resets the drive after a fault.

registers.name: Base block
registers.description: Bit 2: 1 turns B.B. on (outputs blocked).

registers.name: Error code
registers.description: Low byte of the register: fault code, 0 when there is no fault (codes as in the manual's fault table).

registers.name: Warning code
registers.description: High byte of the register: warning code, 0 when there is no warning.

registers.name: Run state
registers.description: Bits 1-0 of the status word.

registers.name: Jog active
registers.description: Bit 2: 1 while a jog command is active.

registers.name: Direction state
registers.description: Bits 4-3 of the status word.

registers.name: Frequency from communication
registers.description: Bit 8: 1 when the master frequency comes from the serial interface.

registers.name: Frequency from analog
registers.description: Bit 9: 1 when the master frequency comes from an analog signal.

registers.name: Run command from communication
registers.description: Bit 10: 1 when the operation command comes from the serial interface.

registers.name: Parameters locked
registers.description: Bit 11: 1 when the parameters are locked.

registers.name: Frequency command (readback)
registers.description: Frequency set point in use.

registers.name: Output frequency
registers.description: Output frequency of the drive.

registers.name: Output current
registers.description: Output current, two decimals. Above 655.35 A the decimal point shifts to one decimal; the high byte of 0x211F says which.

registers.name: DC bus voltage
registers.description: DC bus voltage.

registers.name: Output voltage
registers.description: Output voltage.

registers.name: Multi-speed step
registers.description: Step number of the multi-step speed operation now running.

registers.name: Counter value
registers.description: Value of the internal counter.

registers.name: Power factor angle
registers.description: Power factor angle.

registers.name: Output torque
registers.description: Output torque as a percentage of rated.

registers.name: Motor speed
registers.description: Actual motor speed.

registers.name: Output current decimals
registers.description: High byte: decimal places used by the output current display (see 0x2104).

registers.name: Communication frequency
registers.description: Pr.09-10: master frequency used when the frequency source is RS-485. Scaled like the frequency command.

registers.name: Communication address
registers.description: Pr.09-00: Modbus station address of the drive (1 to 254).

registers.name: Communication protocol
registers.description: Pr.09-04: Modbus mode and frame format of COM1.
